name: The Ledger - reconstructed-participant market simulation
hypothesis: Crypto returns are driven by participant constraint rather than chart shape, so a conserved stock-flow-consistent reconstruction of who holds the coins and who holds the dry powder carries information that candle features do not.
phase: 3 of 8 - ledger core and reconstruction, one pair. L0 and L1 exist; L2-L5 do not.
data: Binance BTCUSDT 15m candles with taker_buy_volume - the aggressor/passive split, already in the shared catalogue from 2017-08
chain_total-bitcoins - Bitcoin circulating supply, daily (new, blockchain.info)
stablecoin_supply - DefiLlama total stablecoin float in USD, daily from 2017-11 (new)
etf_flow_btc - US spot BTC ETF creations/redemptions per fund, US$m, daily from 2024-01 (new, Farside); HELD OUT of the reconstruction and used as the V2 anchor
NOT USED YET: open interest, liquidations, exchange reserves, CME COT, on-chain cost basis

helped.what: Use the catalogue's existing 15m taker_buy_volume instead of downloading aggTrades
helped.effect: the aggressor/passive split the design calls the spine was already local; the MVP needed zero tape bytes

helped.what: Allocate flow by desire x capacity rather than desire alone
helped.effect: without it the Zipf size ladder is inert - a rung-12 agent wins the same share as rung-0
helped.evidence: Q1-2024 smoke runs, before and after

helped.effect: the constraint that makes a holder a holder; before it, long-term holders with 60% of the float became the largest day trader in the market

helped.what: Allocate miner selling structurally, before the shared pool
helped.effect: miners were net BUYERS of 105k BTC in H1-2024 while competing for a weighted share; correct sign restored once issuance was pre-allocated

helped.what: Open every agent's cost basis at the opening price
helped.effect: a zero opening basis makes every cohort infinitely profitable on day one and silences every profit-based rule

helped.what: Assert conservation in the hot path, not in a test
helped.effect: both real bugs were caught at the offending bucket and named the offending agent

hurt.what: V2 anchor recovery on the institutional cohort
hurt.effect: NOT RECOVERED - inferred flow beats the naive trend baseline on only 4 of 9 statistics (weekly pearson +0.4512 vs +0.3833, margin +0.068). The ledger machinery added nothing a moving average did not already have.

hurt.what: Declaring the V2 verdict on the single best statistic
hurt.effect: the first implementation reported RECOVERED on weekly pearson alone; a vote over all nine reverses it

hurt.what: Stablecoin float as the cash side before ~2022
hurt.effect: the population cannot fund the observed tape - fill 0.959 in 2020, 0.898 in 2021, worst day 0.160. Pre-2022 exchange cash was mostly fiat and is not observable.

hurt.what: Giving BTC cohorts a share of the whole sector's stablecoin float
hurt.effect: largest modelling liberty in the MVP; btc_cash_share splits by measured BTC share of universe dollar volume, but attention is not allocation
still far too loose - the cohort sheds 2.09M coins in 2021 and falls from 60% to 21.7% of the float over six years

hurt.what: Opening cohort priors COIN_PRIOR and CASH_PRIOR
hurt.effect: asserted rather than measured; they set the level of every stock, so any cohort's reported holdings are a prior with six years of tape on top

open.what: Phase 2, the designed kill switch, was skipped
open.why: the operator asked to go straight to the MVP. Testing the observable proxies as a strict addition to the champion is now the most valuable next step, and V2's result makes it more urgent.

open.what: Is any cohort state identified, or only the institutional one unidentified?
open.why: V2 has been run against one anchor. Open interest and exchange reserves are untested and neither has been downloaded.

open.what: Would calibration change the V2 verdict?
open.why: every constant is an unfitted prior; simulated minimum distance and neural posterior estimation are named in the design and unapplied.

open.what: L2 through L5 do not exist
open.why: no behaviour learning, no market clearing, no forward simulation, no trading policy. Nothing measured here is evidence about them.
BTCUSDT on Binance only; multi-symbol and multi-venue is phase 5 and compute has not been budgeted.

rules: A trade redistributes cash inside the ecosystem; it does not add any. Only the boundary - stablecoin mint/burn, ETF creation/redemption, miner issuance, fees - changes the totals.
Exchange tape is anonymous: participants are latent cohorts pinned by accounting identities and external anchors, never reconstructed wallets.
Wanting and being able to are both required: an allocator that uses capacity only as a cap, never as a weight, silently deletes its own size distribution.
A cohort is defined by its turnover, not only by its opinion; without a rate limit every cohort collapses into whoever holds the most.
Forced flow must be allocated before discretionary flow, or a structural seller stops being structural and changes sign.
A held-out anchor is evidence only when scored against the signal that drove the prediction; without that control you are claiming credit for the trend.
Declare a verdict on a vote over every statistic computed, never on the best one.
Matching stylized facts is necessary and nowhere near sufficient - many different agent populations produce identical ones.
Test the cheap observable proxies before building the expensive simulator that claims to sharpen them.
